welcome.heading: Welcome to Busarialao College.
welcome.text: We began in 2003 as Top Tutors, a small tutorial centre, and became a college in 2006 with nine pioneer learners and one idea: that science should come alive. Today we are a science-focused school [CONFIRM "pure science"], with laboratories, small classes and staff who expect the best of every student.

science.heading: A pure science school, built to push past limits.
science.lead: A pure science college from JSS1 to SS3, and the first dedicated science college in Ilorin.

labs.name: Chemistry
labs.text: Titrations, analysis and safe lab practice.

science.examsText: In-house certification exams for all learners, and preparatory exams for JSS3 and SS3 before the external exams, set through Top Tutors.
